remarks:
Welcome to peace outside the busy village of Fredonia! This irregular plot of land, approximately 22 Acres, once used as a mobile park is cleared and ready for your vision to take it to the next level. Cleared land with a driveway in the front of the property have easy access and concrete borders for easy installation of new trailers or for new building. Used as a seasonal camp you have wooded acreage to explore with a small pond towards the back of the property. Electric meters set up have capacity of 5 with one still functional and running. Two septic systems in place with a leech field for easy connection and public water access. Close proximity to Lake Erie and State Park for more adventures. 
Plenty of land with tons of potential!
